themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to perform research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including their development, capabilities, and limitations.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Focuses on specific AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in various aspects of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Articles discussing AI tools that help developers write, debug, and review code, including their security implications and effectiveness.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of synthetic data or personas for AI training, testing, and simulation purposes, especially in UX and research contexts.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding in information digestion and insight extraction.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Covers how AI tools and techniques are being used to assist product managers in their decision-making, strategy, and execution.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications in testing the usability of AI systems themselves, as well as AI tools for traditional usability testing.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Discusses the use of AI to analyze and interpret user sentiment from various feedback sources, such as reviews, surveys, and social media.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, and assess the effectiveness and value of different AI tools available for UX and research professionals.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, skills, recruitment, and the overall structure of the workforce, particularly in research and design fields.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
